record.question: Which one of these statements about payment of Arbitral Award is incorrect?
options: Payment should be made to the contractor as early as possible once the arbitration award is accepted by the department.
An arbitration award is discharged by the death of any party thereto and no longer enforceable by or against the legal representative of the deceased.
The payments made towards arbitration awards are charged to the work.
Fund for payment against the award will be borne by the client organisation.
record.explanation: An arbitral award is not discharged by death of a party.
